game_concept: A action defense set in Snowy Hold – Northern Wall, the northern wall: the innkeeper must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Docstring Detective: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case.
theme: Snowy Hold – Northern Wall: the northern wall
core_gameplay_loop: In Northern Wall, repeat each round: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case. Each round, blizzard sprites strike the watch bell, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the cases value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the watch bell from blizzard sprites in Northern Wall: keep the cases meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 24-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: cases drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 24-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Docstring Detective
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Docstring Detective' (Week 6 slot 9), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Northern Wall'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cases changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Northern Wall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 24 seconds while cases > 0.
